english.title: Motor vehicle fail to comply with a stop sign - automatic equipment

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2002

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), and failed to comply with the indication given by a traffic sign specified as subject to obligatory endorsement in Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988, namely a stop sign, lawfully placed on or near a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 36(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988, Schedule 9 to the Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2016 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) See offence document H12688 for the same offence detected by manned equipment
(ii) Offence documents H12690 - H12693 cater for the contravention of traffic lights and solid white line road markings
(iii) Non-endorsable section 36 traffic signs are catered for by offence documents H12682 (ACD) and H12683 (non-ACD)
